module_overview.en: Whether you decide to progress to further study or to a career in industry, one of the most important skills expected of an effective graduate in Information Technology Management or Computer Science is the ability to work creatively under the appropriate guidance of an organisation. It is therefore essential that you use and develop the skills and knowledge gained from other modules and from your wider educational and./or working background in a major integrative exercise. This project module is the ideal vehicle for this purpose. You will be expected to develop an idea (guided by a member of academic staff) and demonstrate your ability to develop it further, producing a suitable artefact by applying your technical, analytical, practical and managerial skills in an integrated manner.

learning_outcome.en: LO1 Demonstrate a deep and systematic understanding of a selected specialist area of their subject area, including issues at the forefront of research or professional practice in that area, and this will be demonstrated by your ability to articulate this knowledge in Viva Voce.

learning_outcome.en: LO2 Independently design and undertake a substantial investigation that rigorously tackles a complex problem in an area of the chosen academic subject, selecting appropriate methodological processes and critically evaluating their effectiveness.
learning_outcome.my: LO2 Independently design and undertake a substantial investigation that rigorously tackles a complex problem in an area of the chosen academic subject, selecting appropriate methodological processes and critically evaluating their effectiveness.

learning_outcome.en: LO3 Produce a high level report that encompasses all the requirements of  a level 7 dissertation. The report should have an in- depth literature review, artefact design, implementation and testing, and finally a critical review of the findings of the dissertation.

assessments.en: Dissertation Report (80%) that clearly articulates the artefact designed, developed and tested with scientific evidence on the quality of analysis, originality and depth, research conducted, and references used, and overall presentation including structure and clarity. The dissertation report should also include evidence on the appropriate management of project work (effective meetings with surpervisor, initiatives shown in project definition, documentation , timing, process of investigation, etc)
